stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

tasks.CONTROL_AI_ACCESS: Restrict sensitive data exposure or securely connect internal data/systems to AI -> protected AI data access/integration. An internal workflow or regulated industry alone is insufficient. Image anonymization without an AI linkage is supporting privacy work, not direct AI integration.
tasks.GOVERN_ENTERPRISE_AI: Apply consistent security/operating controls across enterprise AI tools -> governed AI rollout. Require explicit AI/security/governance evidence; never infer it from banking or document processing.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

tasks.CONTROL_AI_ACCESS: Restrict sensitive data exposure or securely connect internal data/systems to AI -> protected AI data access/integration. An internal workflow or regulated industry alone is insufficient. Image anonymization without an AI linkage is supporting privacy work, not direct AI integration.
tasks.GOVERN_ENTERPRISE_AI: Apply consistent security/operating controls across enterprise AI tools -> governed AI rollout. Require explicit AI/security/governance evidence; never infer it from banking or document processing.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. tasks.INTEGRATE_PRODUCTION_DATA: Integrate fragmented production/quality/equipment or functionally equivalent operational process data -> unified operational data for diagnosis/planning.
tasks.DIAGNOSE_QUALITY_CAUSE: Analyze reasons/drivers/root causes of quality defects -> causal diagnosis. Detecting that a defect is present is supporting inspection, NOT cause diagnosis. Survey theme summarization is not causal diagnosis.
tasks.ADJUST_PRODUCTION_PLAN: Adjust operational production schedules when orders/equipment/constraints change -> revised schedule or validated schedule adjustments. Other sectors can transfer the same constrained scheduling operation. Generic initial planning without adjustment evidence is supporting.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

tasks.INTEGRATE_PRODUCTION_DATA: Integrate fragmented production/quality/equipment or functionally equivalent operational process data -> unified operational data for diagnosis/planning.
tasks.DIAGNOSE_QUALITY_CAUSE: Analyze reasons/drivers/root causes of quality defects -> causal diagnosis. Detecting that a defect is present is supporting inspection, NOT cause diagnosis. Survey theme summarization is not causal diagnosis.
tasks.ADJUST_PRODUCTION_PLAN: Adjust operational production schedules when orders/equipment/constraints change -> revised schedule or validated schedule adjustments. Other sectors can transfer the same constrained scheduling operation. Generic initial planning without adjustment evidence is supporting.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

tasks.DIAGNOSE_QUALITY_CAUSE: Analyze reasons/drivers/root causes of quality defects -> causal diagnosis. Detecting that a defect is present is supporting inspection, NOT cause diagnosis. Survey theme summarization is not causal diagnosis.
tasks.ADJUST_PRODUCTION_PLAN: Adjust operational production schedules when orders/equipment/constraints change -> revised schedule or validated schedule adjustments. Other sectors can transfer the same constrained scheduling operation. Generic initial planning without adjustment evidence is supporting.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

tasks.INTEGRATE_PRODUCTION_DATA: Integrate fragmented production/quality/equipment or functionally equivalent operational process data -> unified operational data for diagnosis/planning.
tasks.DIAGNOSE_QUALITY_CAUSE: Analyze reasons/drivers/root causes of quality defects -> causal diagnosis. Detecting that a defect is present is supporting inspection, NOT cause diagnosis. Survey theme summarization is not causal diagnosis.
tasks.ADJUST_PRODUCTION_PLAN: Adjust operational production schedules when orders/equipment/constraints change -> revised schedule or validated schedule adjustments. Other sectors can transfer the same constrained scheduling operation. Generic initial planning without adjustment evidence is supporting.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.

stage1.system:
Judge only this ONE query and named target using the supplied Problem/Task/Context, never unseen implementation, technology or outcomes. WHOLE_QUERY means any explicitly defined core task can give 3; ASPECT means ONLY the selected task, never borrow another task from the whole query. Compare ACTION, FUNCTIONAL OBJECT and OUTPUT. Other sectors, recipient roles and channels can transfer the same operation: answering employee, partner, legal, banking or shopping questions can match inquiry answering. Do not demand an unstated demonstrated benefit for a direct functional match. Conversely, generic manual work, staff capacity, cost/time reduction or industry overlap cannot turn a different task into a direct match. Summarizing, extracting, verifying and identifying next actions are distinct operations; defect detection differs from cause diagnosis.
Grades: 0 no operational link (manual work/industry alone is zero); 1 broad task/object resemblance without a concrete supporting operation; 2 an upstream/downstream supporting operation, or only some A/O/O elements match; 3 direct ACTION plus functionally equivalent OBJECT plus OUTPUT for at least one target task; 4 additionally most target tasks and explicit problem/context requirements are supported in the input. Never invent workload reduction, response quality, complexity-handling gains, AI technology, security or regulation. Static contract/website/review summaries are not business-conversation summaries. A specific inquiry type still counts as inquiry answering; cross-industry usefulness is allowed. Read ALL the raw fields.
Return the exact JSON structure, query and target IDs. Each case has its own schema/evidence choices; never transfer a score or evidence to another case. Set match_mask to three digits in ACTION/OBJECT/OUTPUT order: 1 means a direct functional match, 0 means supporting/different/unstated. Score>=3 requires 111 and relation DIRECT. matched_tasks is a unique list of actually performed selected tasks, or [NONE] if none is direct. Score4 requires problem_context SUPPORTED, not a hypothesized benefit. Evidence must be one supplied exact source excerpt. reason must be exactly three short phrases separated by ' / ': action comparison / functional object comparison / output comparison. At most 35 whitespace-delimited English words total. Explain only these comparisons, not effects, technologies or speculative purposes. These are AI judgments, not human Gold. A need or burden in the case Problem is NOT evidence that the case Task performs an action or produces its output. Judge actual actions/outputs from Task and explicit operational Context only; Problem supplies problem/context evidence, not missing capabilities. Grade4 must cover more than half the selected tasks (one of one, both of two, at least two of three), AND its named problem constraints, using stated evidence. One matching task in a two-task whole query gives at most3. Functional transfer across sectors/recipient roles is allowed; do not turn a missing workload/quality outcome into a requirement for grade3.
